reasons: The cited clause matches the playbook's preferred position on all material terms: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000 (§21.1), mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (§21.2), and an 'Excluded Claims' definition that places confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP outside the cap with no super-cap (§21.3).

The 'Fees' definition resolves to recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees payable under an Order Form, so the fees-based limb is not illusory; the USD 1,000,000 floor further protects Customer.
§21.3 expressly confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not 'damages', matching the preferred carve-out; §21.4 preserves non-limitable liability.

Consistent with the compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs; deterministic checks confirm a 12-month fees/fixed-floor cap and no unlimited Customer liability language.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue.
